arguments.text: R1 red bat hit white skeleton at x=1620 with wind +2.7 for 24 damage and slow 1. Its public path peaked near y=350 and crossed x=1430 at y=470.
R2: +3.2 wind. White shots at 60°/65, 75 and 82 struck the central wall, reducing it to 76 HP. Skeleton at 60°/92 cleared it and landed x=727. Red bat then hit white wizard x=1234 for 24 and slow.

R3 results: the wall took two more hits (HP 60); shots from nearer starts can clear it, while 60°/65 from white wizard and 60°/82 from white bat consistently impact it. R4 red bat missed under wind -2.8.

R5 +1.7 wind carried 60°/65 from white wizard to x=691 and 60°/82 from the rear units to x=662–713, so positive wind strongly extends leftward shots. Red bat has missed twice after its two opening wizard hits.

R6 decisive calibration: with +2.9 wind, 60°/88 from white knight hit red wizard at x585 for 29 and stun; 60°/100 skeleton hit red bat at x528 for 27.5 plus bleed/stun/weak. Under negative wind, red bat again fell short.

R9 tailwind calibration was accurate: 60°/60 wizard, 70 knight, 80 skeleton and 78 bat all landed around x453–566 and removed red bat through direct damage plus poison. I am using those ranges for the remaining wizard and skeleton.
R10: tailwind shots reduced the skeleton from 70 to zero; the knight's 60°/66 shot put the wizard at 23 HP. With +3.1 headwind I raised power to keep all remaining shots near the wizard.
R11 removed red wizard, leaving only the red knight at x=231 with 140 HP. With +3.3 headwind, max-power rear shots were still short, so surviving units moved forward 72, 144, and 36 px in round 12.
R13 red knight damaged the wall. R14 headwind is still too strong for the remaining distance, so white knight, skeleton, and bat moved forward another 72, 36, and 72 px.
R15: with +3.1 headwind, white knight is now the only unit near enough to threaten the red knight and used 60°/100. Skeleton and bat moved forward another 36 and 72 px.
R15 white knight's 60°/100 struck the last red knight for 23. At +1.7 wind, the advanced skeleton and bat can now reach the same target at max power.

Enemy: only red knight remains at x=231. Its shots can hit white bat but often miss or strike the wall. Calibration: +3.1 headwind, white knight at x1256 hits red knight using 60°/100 (23 damage). At +1.7, that max shot overshoots, so use about 85 from white knight and 91–92 from advanced rear units for x231.
R17: 85/92/91 at +1.6 all hit red knight for 69 total, leaving 46 with bleed. At -1.8, adjusted down to 72/86/84 to finish it.

Enemy red knight was reduced to 15.2 HP after the round-18 white knight critical. At wind +0.4, I selected 60° power 80 (white knight), 88 (skeleton), and 87 (bat) using the public landing calibration.
